name: rask-ui-editor-engine
description: Builds src/Rask.Ui/Resources/ui-editor.js, the lazily loaded engine behind Ui.Editor: npm ci && node build.mjs. Tiptap is npm's latest, every package of the family at one version (scripts/upstream/kit-bundle.mjs follows it daily); prosemirror-model is held to the last one whose serialised HTML is what Flux's live editor answers (no trailing semicolon in a style attribute).
